tasks.short: Interview the client and record their words.

steps.what: List blank plan fields with no risk score
Interview clients about current income and expenses
Record insurance coverage, tax status, and tolerance
Sign the interview note
File the signed interview note
outputs: filed copy of signed interview note v1

tasks.design: A job in {CRM} lists plan fields that are still blank and writes no risk score. The advisor interviews the client and records income, expenses, insurance coverage, tax status, objectives, and risk tolerance in the client's own words. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not score the client.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan was filled from memory after the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Field name and the value the advisor recorded are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The interview stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides what the client's words mean for the plan.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week in the interview, not on the blank list.

reach.task: Correct only the note the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says interviews, debt advice, and declining excessive risk stay with people.
Digest [S12] says credit scoring of natural persons is high-risk, and life and health insurance pricing is high-risk. This design does not score a client and does not price insurance.
Digest [S13] says the high-risk duties apply from 2 December 2027.
Digest [S15] says a score is an automated decision when the lender gives it a determining role. This design does not produce a score.
The executive digest says firms fall outside and sole traders do not. This design does not score a client either way.

assumptions: Field name is stored on the plan record. The plan record produces the blank list from missing values. The advisor records the value during the interview. A blank value is not guessed and is not a risk score.
Native configuration of the plan record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor interviewing clients about income and expenses.

incremental.description: Refresh field name when the plan layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many plan fields are blank. The high end assumes field name and the advisor's recorded value are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compute ratios and choose the strategy.

steps.what: Compute stored ratios over every client record
Analyze financial information obtained from clients
Determine strategies for meeting clients' objectives
Sign the strategy note
File the signed strategy note
outputs: filed copy of signed strategy note v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} computes each stored ratio only over records whose amounts are all stored. The advisor analyzes the financial information and determines the strategies for the client's objectives. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not choose the strategy and it does not decline a risk by a rule.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ratios were worked out on paper before the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Amount and ratio name are already stored on the ledger.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the strategy stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides the strategy, including whether to decline a risk.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the strategy, not on the arithmetic.

reach.task: Hear only the strategy the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says these figures are plain code and configuration in the ledger.
The executive digest says checks are rules over every record, and exceptions go to a person.
Digest [S10] says most models in a published test ended a cash waterfall at the wrong figure. This design checks every figure against a source row.
The executive digest says interviews, debt advice, and declining excessive risk stay with people.

assumptions: Amount and ratio name are stored on the ledger record. The ledger record produces them. A ratio is computed only over records whose amounts are all stored. A blank amount is not treated as zero. An exception is listed for the advisor. The job does not choose the strategy.
Native configuration of the ledger record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor analyzing financial information obtained from clients.

incremental.description: Refresh amount and ratio name when the ledger layout changes, and drop a strategy the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many amounts are blank. The high end assumes amount and ratio name are stored on every record in the set. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer plan questions from stored facts.

steps.what: List the stored plan fact for the question
Answer clients' questions about purposes and details
Explain the financial plans and the strategies
Sign the answer note
File the signed answer note
outputs: filed copy of signed answer note v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists the stored fact for the question. The advisor answers the client's questions about purposes, details, plans, and strategies. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not speak to the client and it is not a chatbot.
tasks.previous_blocker: Answers were given without the stored fact in front of the advisor.
tasks.enabler_now: Question identifier and stored fact are already on the plan.
tasks.still_hard: The answer stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides which stored fact fits the question.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the questions, not on listing facts.

reach.task: Rely only on the answer the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The advisor answers from a stored plan fact. A blank fact is not quoted. This design does not use a chatbot.

assumptions: Question identifier and stored fact are stored on the plan record. The plan record produces them. A blank fact is not quoted. The advisor answers. This design does not use a chatbot.
Native configuration of the plan record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor answering clients' questions about purposes and details.

incremental.description: Refresh question identifier and stored fact when the plan layout changes, and drop an answer the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many stored facts are blank. The high end assumes question identifier and stored fact are present. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review the plan when figures differ.

steps.what: Compare stored figures with the signed plan
Review clients' accounts and plans regularly
Judge economic changes and environmental concerns
Determine whether performance changes indicate reassessment
Sign the reassessment note
File the signed reassessment note
outputs: filed copy of signed reassessment note v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} lists a difference only when a stored figure and the signed plan amount are both present and they differ. The advisor reviews the accounts and plans, and judges life changes, economic changes, environmental concerns, and financial performance. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not reassess the plan by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reassessment waited for an annual meeting even when the figures had moved.
tasks.enabler_now: Account identifier, figure amount, and plan amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The judgement stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides whether the change is a reason to reassess.

ambition.what: Sign the reassessment the day a stored figure and the signed plan differ.

tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the review, not on the comparison.

reach.task: Discuss only the reassessment the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says these figures are plain code and configuration in the ledger.
The executive digest says checks are rules over every record, and exceptions go to a person.
Digest [S10] says most models in a published test ended a cash waterfall at the wrong figure. This design checks every figure against a source row.

assumptions: Account identifier, figure amount, and plan amount are stored on the plan record. The plan record produces them. A difference is listed only when both amounts are stored and they differ. A blank amount is not a difference and is not treated as zero. The job does not reassess the plan.
Native configuration of the plan record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor reviewing clients' accounts and plans regularly.

incremental.description: Refresh account identifier, figure amount, and plan amount when the plan layout changes, and drop a reassessment the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many figure amounts are blank. The high end assumes figure amount and plan amount are both stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The advisor spends the week with the client and on the signed note. A stored ratio, a missing-field list, and filing that signature can move. The advisor still interviews, recommends, and decides.
reach: A client receives only the text the advisor signed.
A creditor is paid only the disbursement the advisor signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a ratio that treats a blank figure as zero.
Reject a report whose figure has no source row.
Reject a payment the advisor has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed plan note can be filed the same day, and the advisor still decides the strategy.
